onset.Description: Start of the event in seconds from the first sample of the recording (BAD_nan: index of the first NaN sample / sampling frequency).

duration.Description: Duration of the event (BAD_nan: number of samples in the NaN run / sampling frequency).

Levels.BAD_nan: Not-a-number (NaN) samples in the signal file: from onset, for duration seconds, at least one channel that is not NaN throughout holds NaN instead of a value (channels per run in code/fix-20261019_nan_spans.tsv). Added on 19 Oct 2026 from a scan of every sample of the data; the data files are unchanged. MNE-BIDS reads this row as an annotation whose name starts with BAD, so MNE can leave these samples out (reject_by_annotation).

sample.Description: Index (0-based) of the first sample of the event in the data file.
